title: I've been working on a multiplayer snowball game with cute animals, and it's finally playable!
author: Lonely-Magician-2704
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on a little game called BONKIMALS! for a while now, and I finally decided to put the first version on itch.io.

It's basically a multiplayer arena game where you play as different animals and throw snowballs at each other. You can jump into quick matches or create a private party to play with friends.

I've also been working on things like character customization, missions, rewards and leaderboards to give players something to do between matches.

There's still a lot I want to add and improve, but I felt it was time to let other people try it instead of just testing everything myself.

It's completely free and available on Windows for now.

If anyone feels like giving it a try, I'd really appreciate some feedback. Especially on how the gameplay feels, or if you come across any bugs.

Here's the [itch.io](http://itch.io) page:

[https://bitrabble.itch.io/bonkimals](https://bitrabble.itch.io/bonkimals)

Thanks to anyone who takes the time to check it out!
